pressure_note: not stated (ordinary pressure; pycnometer and dilatometer work at 25 C)
volume_basis_evidence: concentration column headed 'c/mole l.-1' (mole per litre)
title_as_printed: Densities and apparent molar volumes of concentrated electrolyte solutions

value.what: density of the solution at 25 C (printed d4^25; author used 0.99707 g/ml for water at 25 C so the number is the density in g/ml); the measured quantity (two 50 ml Ostwald pycnometers, duplicates agree within 3 parts in 1e5)

salt_from_column.parse: text after the comma gives the salt formula (HCl, KNO3, K2SO4, Na2SO4, MgCl2, CaCl2, BaCl2, LaCl3); the number before the comma is the stock-solution label

composition.other_species: in-scope salts: Na2SO4, MgCl2, CaCl2; out of the six-ion set: HCl, KNO3, K2SO4, BaCl2, LaCl3 (rows kept)

extra_unmapped: phi_V/ml mole-1 (apparent molar volume, calculated by the author from the density; derived_by_authors)
conversion_needs: molarity (mol per litre of solution) to molality needs the density in column d4 25 (a molar mass is also needed)
notes: Subscript digits in the printed c and d4 25 columns (last significant digit written as a subscript) are written here as ordinary trailing digits: 0.8362 sub 4 -> 0.83624, 1.01179 sub 9 -> 1.011799. Text layer dropped the density column and misread two cells (row 11 MgCl2 c 0.69282 -> 0.69182 and row 16 CaCl2 phi_V 22.46 -> 21.46, both checked on the image). 27 rows.
